rule: trap landing sheets; play at the target cell when the thrown item arrives; ground layer under fighters, air layer over; anchor = cell centre on the ground (scale with the testbed hex size)

explosiveTag.note: Explosive Tag: kunai with a paper tag sticks in the ground, the tag sizzles, white flash, fireball, smoke rises, scorch mark fades with the last frame. Hit fighters play hitReact on frame 3.

flashBomb.note: Flash Bomb: pellet lands, a white star flash with yellow rays fills the area and fades to sparkles. Blinded fighters play hitReact (squint) on frame 2; the testbed may also white out the screen for one frame.

smokeScreen.note: Smoke Screen (radius 2): pellet lands, smoke billows out into a bank that covers the area; loop the linger frames while the Smoke terrain lasts (2 rounds), then play the two dispersal frames.

caltrops.note: Caltrops / Scatter Nails: the handful lands, bouncing once, and lies across the cell; loop the linger frames (glints) while the hazard lasts (3 rounds). Fighters standing on it play hitReact when it bites.

spikePit.note: Spike Pit: an iron stake drives into the ground, cracks run out, the ground drops into a pit and spikes spring up (overshoot, settle). Loop the linger frames (glints) for the 3 rounds; spikes are an air layer so they stand in front of a fighter in the pit.

inFlight.rule: item drawn along the flight from the thrower release event to the cell: arc height 0.35 x distance for pellets and the stake, 0.15 for the tag kunai (spins nose-first), caltrops fan into 4 singles
